firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently had a volcanic or emotional outburst starts the first round.
clarifications: In later rounds, the player whose returned Volcano card has the most birds starts.
Play proceeds clockwise after the start player reveals a Location.
internalEvidence: Rendered PDF/printed page 2 gives the initial outburst criterion and clockwise play; page 3 gives the later-round bird rule.
